modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow safety hazards and preventive techniques during fire drill
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
ensure workstation and equipment are regularly clean and sanitized
clean hands with soap, alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose PPEs regularly and appropriately
report advanced hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority
follow stress and anxiety management techniques

modules.module_title: Perform work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: ensure that work is accomplished as per the requirements within the specified timeline
ensure team goals are given preference over individual goals
follow the fundamentals of 5S for waste management
segregate waste into different categories
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
report malfunctioning (fumes/ sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of equipment
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: identify the fInal output product based on engineering drawing
identify the tools, measuring instruments and input materials required for the job
check the raw material, tools and equipment for any defects and that they are as per the required quality standards
follow the tooling instructions for fixtures, cutting tools, jigs, gauges etc., as specified in the Operating Manual/Work Instructions and collect all the required items from the store
set-up the conventional lathe machine to perform turning operations
adjust the machine controls to ensure conformance with the specified tolerances
mount, install and align tools, attachments and fixtures on machine by using hand tools and precision measuring instruments
lift the work piece/metal stock manually or by hoist, position the same securely on the machine bed by using workholding devices and verify their positions with measuring instruments if required
select and install pre-set toolings in tool posts
set the machine parameters like cutting speed, depth of cut and feed rate and position cutting tool and work piece as per work instructions
move cutter or turning hand wheel manually for machining the work piece as per the required specifications
start the turning machine, produce the component and inspect the first-run piece for conformance to specifications by using precision gauges
run the machine for mass production of components, if the first run-piece meets the specified requirements
check the component as per the control plan, work instructions for product quality
note down the observations of the basic inspection process and identify pieces which are as per the specified standards
separate the completed pieces into Ok pieces and defective pieces which can be repaired/reworked and pieces which are beyond repair and maintain records of each category
observe the machine operations for any malfunctions/defects in the component and immediately inform the supervisor/maintenance team for correction
replace worn out tools timely and safely with new tools and perform minor maintenance activities
